title: La Jarana de Tlacotalpan, VISTA STORIES
comment: jarana-tlacotalpan (VISTA): puesto de jaranas en la plaza de Tlacotalpan, Veracruz, durante la fiesta. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.MATIAS_REYES: Mexican man from Veracruz, old jarana luthier, 72 years old, thin, dark-brown skin, short white curly hair, a white mustache, a white guayabera with embroidery, white trousers, a red bandana around his neck, sandals, his hands empty.
chars.ISMAEL_REYES: Mexican man from Veracruz, 26 years old, brown skin, short curly black hair, a light stubble, a plain light-blue cotton shirt with rolled sleeves, jeans, sandals, his hands empty.
chars.LORENA_OCHOA: Mexican woman, 40 years old, light skin, long straight light-brown highlighted hair, big gold earrings, red lipstick, an elegant white off-shoulder dress, gold sandals, holding a fan.
chars.CRISTINA_AGUIRRE: Mexican matriarch from Veracruz, 68 years old, elegant, light-brown skin, silver hair in a neat bun with a red flower, a black embroidered dress with a black lace shawl, pearl earrings, holding a closed black fan.

locs.LOC_PLAZATLACOTALPAN: Colonial plaza in Tlacotalpan, Veracruz, during the town festival in the afternoon: brightly painted one-story houses with arcades in blue, pink and yellow, a small wooden stall with handmade jarana guitars hanging, papel picado without letters overhead, palm trees, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
